verdict.rationale: Gemini lets users upload documents, spreadsheets, code, and connect Gmail/Drive/other apps to get answers, summaries, and insights about their data (gemini-docs-25, gemini-docs-29, gemini-docs-30), with independent corroboration of practical insight-generation like OCR/document processing and meeting transcript analysis (gemini-comm-17, gemini-comm-10, gemini-comm-19). missing for 10: quantified accuracy/reliability data across data types, and broader independent validation beyond a few anecdotal community reports.
